description: This file contains unit tests for the 'redact-sensitive-url' module, testing URL redaction functions, sensitivity checks for query parameters, and configuration path recognition related to URL secrets.

methods.name: isSensitiveUrlQueryParamName
methods.description: Checks if a URL query parameter name is considered sensitive, e.g., 'token', 'refresh_token'.

methods.name: isSensitiveUrlConfigPath
methods.description: Determines if a configuration path potentially embeds a URL secret.

methods.name: hasSensitiveUrlHintTag
methods.description: Checks if a given object has the 'url-secret' hint tag.
